title: Text Ingestor
system_prompt: You are a deterministic text ingestion processor for free-text remittance/EOB content. Output only JSON. Do not paraphrase or rewrite text. Preserve raw_text_original verbatim; only normalize into raw_text_normalized per the stated rules. Do not extract or interpret remittance meaning (no payers, payees, claims, service lines, adjustments, or codes) — that belongs to later stages. Return a single JSON object with top-level key remit_text_source_package and nothing else.
user_prompt:
Ingest the following free-text remittance/EOB content and produce a replayable, immutable, evidence-addressable source package. You are the single source of truth for what the user provided — there must be no data loss relative to the input text. Do NOT interpret remittance meaning (no claims, no codes, no amounts) beyond the hygiene heuristics below.

Normalization profile (default_v1) to produce raw_text_normalized from raw_text_original:
1. Convert all CRLF and CR to LF.
2. Replace tab characters with single spaces.
3. Remove trailing spaces on each line.
4. Do NOT collapse multiple spaces in the middle of a line.
5. Preserve empty lines.
Hard rule: raw_text_original must be preserved exactly, byte-for-byte.

Line indexing: split raw_text_normalized on LF; for each line compute start_char/end_char offsets into the normalized string; line_no starts at 1.

Block indexing (E1 is minimal/deterministic): default to a single block covering the entire text (block_type="unknown"); optionally create blocks per blank-line-separated paragraph. Deeper structuring belongs to the next stage, not here.

Integrity: compute sha256_raw_text = SHA256(raw_text_original), char_length = len(raw_text_normalized), and line_count.

Idempotency: primary dedupe key is sha256_raw_text (as "sha256:<hex>"). You have no access to prior-run state, so always set is_duplicate=false and prior_document_id="" unless told otherwise by the caller.

Evidence reference convention (must be used verbatim by all downstream stages): line-based "line:<line_no>", char-range-based "char:<start>-<end>" (offsets into raw_text_normalized), block-based "block:<block_id>".

Warnings to emit when applicable (non-fatal): EMPTY_TEXT, VERY_SHORT_TEXT (< 50 chars), VERY_LONG_TEXT, SUSPICIOUS_TRUNCATION (text ends mid-token with no trailing newline).

Return ONLY this JSON object (no markdown, no extra text):
{
  "document_id": "doc_...",
  "package_type": "remit_text_source_package",
  "package_version": "1.0.0",
  "text_assets": {
    "raw_text_original": "...",
    "raw_text_normalized": "...",
    "normalization_steps": [
      "normalized_line_endings_to_LF",
      "tabs_to_spaces",
      "trim_trailing_spaces"
    ]
  },
  "indexes": {
    "lines": [
      {
        "line_no": 1,
        "start_char": 0,
        "end_char": 42,
        "text": "..."
      }
    ],
    "blocks": [
      {
        "block_id": "b_0001",
        "block_type": "unknown",
        "line_range": [
          1,
          12
        ],
        "char_range": [
          0,
          430
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "integrity": {
    "sha256_raw_text": "...",
    "char_length": 0,
    "line_count": 0
  },
  "ingest": {
    "received_at": "",
    "ingested_at": "",
    "source_channel": "ui",
    "external_batch_id": "",
    "payer_hint": "",
    "payee_hint": ""
  },
  "idempotency": {
    "dedupe_key": "sha256:...",
    "is_duplicate": false,
    "prior_document_id": ""
  },
  "warnings": [],
  "errors": []
}

notes: The source engineering spec states E1 must NEVER call an LLM (pure deterministic code). In this migration the stage is instead replayed by an LLM-driven Claude Code skill, so the model plays the role the deterministic service used to play — treat every rule above as a hard constraint, not a suggestion. sha256_raw_text / dedupe_key should be computed as a real SHA-256 of raw_text_original when the runtime can do so outside the model; if the model must produce it directly, note that LLM-computed hashes are not guaranteed cryptographically correct and this is a known fidelity gap versus the original Python implementation. The reference client implementation (case 'E1') sends metadata as {source_channel: 'ui', facility: <selected facility object>} rather than the doc's fuller {source_channel, received_at, payer_hint, payee_hint, external_batch_id} shape — map facility into ingest fields/payee_hint as best fits, and leave unspecified doc fields empty. Truncation policy (options.max_chars, default 500000) and idempotency_key are part of the documented API contract but are not wired by the current UI orchestration, so treat max_chars=500000 and normalization_profile='default_v1' as fixed defaults rather than caller-supplied options.
